teaching_structure.teaching_activities:
Anawasalimu wanafunzi na kuwauliza kama wanapenda kuchora.
Anawaeleza kuwa kuandika ni kama kuchora, na leo watajifunza kuchora mistari iliyonyooka ambayo itawasaidia kuandika herufi.
teaching_structure.learning_activities:
Wanasalimia mwalimu.
Wanasikiliza maelezo ya mwalimu.
Wanashika penseli zao vizuri.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Stadi za awali za kuandika zimetumika

teaching_structure.teaching_activities:
Anawaongoza wanafunzi kuchora mistari hiyo kwenye hewa kwa kutumia kidole.
Anawapa karatasi zenye mistari iliyonyooka ya kufuatia (dotted lines).
teaching_structure.learning_activities:
Anatembea darasani akisaidia wanafunzi kushika penseli vizuri na kufuatia mistari.
Anawatia moyo wanafunzi kutochoka.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria:
Stadi za awali za kuandika
zimetumika

teaching_structure.teaching_activities:
Anawapa karatasi tupu na kuwaagiza wachore mistari iliyonyooka mingi kadri wawezavyo bila kufuatia.
Anawaomba wachore picha rahisi inayotumia mistari iliyonyooka (mfano: nyumba, mti).
teaching_structure.learning_activities:
Wanachora mistari iliyonyooka kwenye karatasi tupu.
Wanachora picha zinazotumia mistari iliyonyooka.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria:
Stadi za awali za kuandika
zimetumika

teaching_structure.learning_activities: Kujibu maswali, kufanya kazi za ziada, kushiriki katika mjadala, jibu maswali ya kadi mwambato
